independent_findings: The policy is phase-managed measurement of actual pre/post native health followed by phase retirement and teardown. All root/part source admission, arrow subclass response, helpers, cues, counters, manager and own persistence belong to one whole at most.

Parent multipart damage checks DYING, then phase onHurt, then nonhead scaling and .01 threshold. Only Player-owned or the actual ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS damage tag reaches reallyHurt; other admitted source returns true without parent damage.

AbstractDragonSittingPhase ignites a direct AbstractArrow for one second then returns zero before source-owner eligibility. HOVERING isSitting true but inherits unchanged onHurt from AbstractDragonPhaseInstance. Boolean sitting is not arrow-denial subtype identity.
Parent records f=getHealth, invokes superclass hurt and ignores its return, then re-queries current phase. This is not a frozen phase lease across hook consumers.

In then-current sitting phase f-currentHP feeds sittingDamageReceived; strictly above .25*maxHP resets zero and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly threshold stays. An absorbed/canceled hit can contribute zero; hook-induced heal can algebraically reduce the counter. No demonstrated exploit or runtime outcome.

Observed-HP accumulation differs from Lycanites successfed nominal per-second quota+nexttick rollback and Minister refused-hit staff nominal expenditure. It also differs from Wilden absolute HP threshold clamp and Gaia elapsed phase timers. These whole prior owners remain zero extra.

Closest Draconic whole already owns source/part/phase gates, true-without-HP and nonstationary lethal HP1/DYING support, so those overlapping ideas are zero new. Its complete523..584 does not measure and accumulate sitting HP deltas to retire via TAKEOFF; this measured-delta lifecycle supports at most one related whole, no universal novelty claim.

Manager end-before-new-instance/server DATA_PHASE-write/begin and root at-most-one immediate second server phase tick are actual source transitions. Phase-owned flaming end discards its cloud. Normal source return is assumed; hook exceptions, network and engine scheduling are unproved.

Landing resets flame count; scanning may choose takeoff/charge without damage; attacking postincrements a40 tick condition then enters flaming; flaming200 or count4 can choose scan/takeoff. Those counters are not new research references or measured wall seconds.

Only root field declaration/update/threshold/reset occur in complete lexical search. Relevant complete phase begin/end methods show no additional accumulator reset. Own save/read persists DragonPhase/DragonDeathTime but omits accumulator; not full external serialization or native reopen proof.

LivingEntity hurt actuallyHurt apply hooks, invulnerability, side/dead, cooldown, armor/magic/absorption and final hook before health mutation, while broadcasts, knockback, death/totem calls may precede return. HP1 assignment after return cannot certify rollback of all death side effects or runtime resurrection.

Root crystal healing before phase dispatch uses direct setHealth and does not edit this accumulator. Crystal destruction requests head explosion10 then dispatches to current phase; exact merged tag contents and fight creation remain unreviewed.

Own addEffect/ride/dimension refusals are supporting context zero and cannot be treated as a complete generic control-immunity feedback implementation. Existing sounds/particles are phase/death cues without a new per-target denial receipt.
author_observations_all14_retained: Own constructor instantiates eight parent-bound parts, MAX_HEALTH attribute200, native initial HOVERING manager and DATA_PHASE initialization; phase enum maps11 actual classes, manager lazily caches instances, ends prior phase, server-writes phase ID then begins new phase.

Part.hurt first consults own isInvulnerableTo, then passes actual part to parent. Server root.hurt passes body; root client returns false. Parent multipart overload has no own explicit side gate; do not assert every part call independently server-gated.

Whole parent admission: current DYING rejects before onHurt; current phase onHurt runs before non-head amount/4+min(amount,1); resulting amount<.01 rejects; otherwise only Player owner or ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS tag calls reallyHurt. Other source returns true without calling native parent damage.

AbstractDragonSittingPhase onHurt lights direct AbstractArrow for1second then returns0. Other sources inherit unchanged amount. Phase/refusal mutates the direct arrow before source eligibility; no refusal text/unique status/target-window feedback produced here. Lighting is a source state request, not measured pixels/audio.

Crucial subtype boundary: initial HOVERING reports isSitting true but inherits AbstractDragonPhaseInstance.onHurt unchanged, not AbstractDragonSittingPhase. Sitting-budget eligibility must not be equated with arrow-refusal eligibility.

For eligible source capture f=current HP then invoke reallyHurt->LivingEntity.hurt; wrapper ignores bool. Afterward current phase is queried again, so no claim of a captured immutable phase across parent hooks. If HP<=0 and then-current phase not sitting, setHealth1 and switch DYING.

If then-current phase is sitting, add f-currentHP to private sittingDamageReceived, regardless native hurt bool. Strictly >.25*maxHP resets accumulator0 and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly25% does not trigger. This is observed pre/post HP difference, not raw attack amount nor success-event nominal damage quota.

Private accumulator has only declaration and update/threshold/reset occurrences in complete root lexical screen; phase begin/end/ordinary takeoff and landing methods contain no accumulator reset. Native own save/read writes DragonPhase and DragonDeathTime, not accumulator. Do not infer external serializers or full replacement/load execution.

Native LivingEntity.hurt has attack hook/invulnerability/client/dead/fire/iframe gates, actuallyHurt applies hurt hook/armor/magic/absorption/final damage hook and setHealth.
